description: This file defines extension methods for configuring default services in an ASP.NET Core application, including health checks, OpenTelemetry, service discovery, resilience, and endpoints mapping.

classes.name: Extensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for adding default services, configuring OpenTelemetry, health checks, and endpoint mapping in a .NET host builder or web application.

methods.name: AddServiceDefaults
methods.description: Configures default services such as health checks, service discovery, and resilience for the host application builder.

methods.name: ConfigureOpenTelemetry
methods.description: Sets up OpenTelemetry logging and metrics instrumentation within the host application builder.

methods.name: AddOpenTelemetryExporters
methods.description: Configures and adds OpenTelemetry exporters based on configuration settings, currently supporting OTLP exporter.

methods.name: AddDefaultHealthChecks
methods.description: Adds a basic health check that reports liveness status.

methods.name: MapDefaultEndpoints
methods.description: Maps health check endpoints for development environments, with additional comments on security considerations.
